query: Show me the 10 most recent emails in my Outlook inbox.
expected_behavior: FIRST try `membrane action list --intent="list recent emails" --connectionId=$CONN --json` to discover a pre-built action
OR if going straight to the proxy, use `membrane request $CONN '/me/messages?$top=10&$select=subject,from,receivedDateTime'`
explain WHY action-list-first is preferred (pagination + field mapping handled)
if the user doesn't have $CONN set, point at `connection list` to find the connectionId
notes: Guards the discover-before-build principle AND tests that the Graph API path is findable for the fallback case.
